LanguageData.KMH_DuplicateMod_Title: Colony Nexus is installed more than once
LanguageData.KMH_DuplicateMod_Body: RimWorld found more than one copy of Colony Nexus and runs only one of them:
LanguageData.KMH_DuplicateMod_Fix: Close RimWorld, delete the ignored copies and start it again. An old KMHPatch folder can go entirely: the mod now lives in the ColonyNexus folder, and your settings and account moved with it. A Steam Workshop copy is removed by unsubscribing.

LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Subtitle: Connected Worlds: find a server, bring your friends, federate your guild.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Rw17: Plays on RimWorld 1.7, together with RimWorld Together's own 1.7 release (26.10.20.1 or newer).
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Look: A new Colony Nexus look: a full-screen loading screen with real progress and tips, a Colony Nexus card on the main menu and a tidier Colony Nexus tab.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Leaderboards: Leaderboards: 22 boards in Server Standings, and the same rankings on the Colony Nexus website, with images to share.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Browser: Find a server from the main menu: the Colony Nexus server browser shows each server's status, players, versions and the mods it expects, and Join connects through RimWorld Together's own login.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Mods: Prepare and join: one button shows what a server needs, then subscribes and downloads its Workshop mods, installs its RimWorld Together version, sets your mod list (yours is kept and can be restored), restarts RimWorld, checks what loaded and joins.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Account: Link a Colony Nexus Global account through Steam with a short code: one username, friends, presence, direct messages and Global Chat that follow you between servers. Global is optional - every server still plays without it.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Federation: Guild Federation: guilds on different servers join one federation with renown, weekly objectives and small local bonuses. Silver, items and resources never move between servers.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Enforcement: A server's mod settings are applied while you join, before the world loads: accept once, and reconnecting only re-checks your files - at most one restart, and none when nothing changed.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Sites: Sites are worked by colonists, not accounts: put several of your colonists on one site and recall them one at a time.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Discord: Link Discord from Account & Links. Rich Presence shows the server you are playing on (private servers stay unnamed); what you are doing in game is shown too, and Mod settings can turn that off.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Update: Everyone updates together: v1.3.1 speaks protocol v3, and a Patch and Server Addon from different generations say so and stay off instead of half-working.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Reports: Report a bug or an idea from the Colony Nexus tab, Advanced & tools or the main menu. You see the screenshot and the diagnostics before anything is sent, and the window says who received it.
LanguageData.KMH_WhatsNew_Performance: Smoother online play: sending never holds up a frame, large updates are put together off the game's thread, and a large compressed update no longer drops the connection. Advanced & tools shows your frame rate, game speed and what Colony Nexus costs each frame.
LanguageData.KMH_Report_ButtonTip: Tell the server owner and the Colony Nexus team what went wrong or what you would like. A screenshot and diagnostics can go with it - you see both before anything is sent.

LanguageData.KMH_Tip_1: Open the Colony Nexus tab to trade with other players: the Marketplace, the Want Board and timed auctions.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_2: Your treasury vault keeps silver and goods off the map. A deposit counts once your colony has been saved.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_3: Guilds share a vault, ranks and perks. Start one or accept an invite in the Guild Hall.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_4: Frontier Operations are derelict and contested places anyone can claim, for themselves or for their guild.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_5: Roadworks plans a route on the world map and quotes the cost before you commit to building it.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_6: Server Standings ranks players, guilds and colonies. The website shows every board for this server.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_7: Mail can carry silver and items, and you can recall it while it is still unread.
LanguageData.KMH_Tip_8: Link Steam under Account so your name and history follow you to every Colony Nexus server.

LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ShowWhatsNew: Show Colony Nexus What's New after an update
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ShowWhatsNewTip: If enabled, the What's New changelog appears once after each new version. Reopen it any time from the Colony Nexus About panel.

LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ShowWelcomeTip: If enabled, the welcome appears the first time Colony Nexus starts. You can always reopen it from the Colony Nexus About panel.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_WelcomeAgain: Show the welcome again next launch
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_MuteChat: Mute all Colony Nexus chat notifications
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_MuteChatTip: When on, no chat popups or sounds appear - the unread badge and tab glow still update. You can also toggle this from the Communications window.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordPresence: Show your Colony Nexus activity in Discord
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordPresenceTip: Replaces RimWorld Together's own 'Playing Multiplayer' with what you are doing - defending a raid, weathering a toxic fallout, out with a caravan - and the server you are on. Anyone who can see your Discord status can see this.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordGameplay: Show what is happening in your colony
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordGameplayTip: Raids, disasters, caravans, research and ceremonies, worded generally. Never names, items, amounts or quest details.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordSimple: Simple - in a colony, or multiplayer
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordMultiplayer: Show that you are playing multiplayer
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordMultiplayerTip: Off: a multiplayer game reads like any other colony, with no server, player count or Join.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordServerNameTip: A publicly listed server's name. Off shows 'Colony Nexus multiplayer' instead.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordColonyInfoTip: Adds how many colonists you have and which day it is.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordElapsedTip: Discord's elapsed clock, restarting with each colony or server.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordUpdateHelp: A raid starting is sent within seconds whatever this says; everything else waits its turn.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordAppIdHelp: Colony Nexus's own Discord application by default. Leave it blank and Colony Nexus sets no status at all - RimWorld Together's own is left exactly as it is. Only change it if you run your own Discord application with the Colony Nexus artwork uploaded to it.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordAllowJoin: Let friends join from your Discord status
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordAllowJoinTip: Adds a Join button, but only for a server that is publicly listed AND has no password. Joining always reconnects through your own Colony Nexus server list, never an address someone sent you. Registers one per-user entry so Discord can start RimWorld through Steam.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordNamePrivate: Name private servers in your Discord status
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordNamePrivateTip: Off by default: a server that is not publicly listed shows as 'On a private server'. Turn this on to show its name instead.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordActivity: Show which Colony Nexus screen you are on
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DiscordActivityTip: Shows which Colony Nexus screen you are on - the marketplace, the auction house, the frontier - and nothing else. Never amounts, item names, other players or private names. Never on a private server.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ResetWindows: Reset Colony Nexus window sizes and positions
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_VideoInfo: Video links are fetched and served by the Colony Nexus server you are on - nothing to install here. Quality is capped by that server.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_AutoLoadImagesTip: Images and GIFs shared in chat load as soon as they appear. Off shows a placeholder naming the host until you click it.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_AutoLoadImagesPrivacy: Loading an image contacts that host directly, which tells it your IP address. Only hosts the server owner trusts (Discord, Giphy, Tenor, Imgur and the like) are ever offered.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ChatOverlay: Show new chat over the map
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ChatOverlayTip: New server, guild and Global Chat lines appear at the bottom left of the map for a few seconds while no chat window is open. They never block a click. Direct messages are left out.
LanguageData.KMH_Chat_OpacityTip: How solid the chat windows are. Click to let more of the map show through; the text stays readable.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_MuteVideosTip: Play videos silently. The volume below is remembered either way, so unmuting returns to it.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_RepeatVideosTip: When on, a video restarts when it reaches the end instead of stopping on the last frame.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_TagDiscordTip: Adds a compact [D] after the Discord mark on relayed messages - [D?] when the sender has no linked Colony Nexus account, so their name is only a Discord display name. The mark itself always shows.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_UseServerColoursTip: Server owners can set a small palette for the Colony Nexus accent and chat channels. Turn this off to use your own colours instead. Colours are decoration only - unread counts, warnings and the Discord mark are always labelled in text as well.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ShowingServerColours: Showing this server's colours (Colony Nexus defaults where the owner set none).
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_HexHelp: Six-digit hex, e.g. E2C16B. Blank uses the Colony Nexus default. Very dark values are lightened so text stays readable.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_BadHex: Not a six-digit hex colour: {0}. The Colony Nexus default is being used for these.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_MarkerOutline: Outline Colony Nexus places on the world map
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_MarkerOutlineTip: Draws the same coloured border RimWorld puts on a settlement you own, around Colony Nexus sites, outposts and your guild hall. The border is the only colour applied - the icon itself always keeps its own artwork.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_UseServerMarkersTip: Server owners can suggest which colours mark your own places and other players'. Turn this off to pick your own. Outpost states - claimable, hostile, derelict - always keep the Colony Nexus colours so a warning cannot be styled into something calm.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_MarkerHexHelp: Six-digit hex, e.g. 6BE26B. Blank uses the Colony Nexus default.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_VerboseLoggingTip: Logs detailed Colony Nexus diagnostics. Off by default so normal play stays quiet. Each session writes its own timestamped file under Colony Nexus/Logs, rotated at 10 MB and kept for 14 days.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_ProtocolLoggingTip: Adds a line for every packet, including the 15-second heartbeat. Only turn this on when asked for it - it produces megabytes over a long session. With it off, heartbeats are summarised once an hour.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_LogShareLabel: When a server asks for my log
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_LogShareAutoOption: Automatically share with any server that asks
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_LogShareNeverHelp: Nothing is ever sent, and you are not prompted.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_LogShareAutoHelp: Sharing starts as soon as a server asks. It ends when you disconnect, or when you stop it here.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_LogShareAskHelp: You get one prompt per server, per session. Nothing is sent unless you say yes, and that answer is dropped when you disconnect.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_LogShareScope: Colony Nexus log lines only - never chat, saves, or hardware/system information.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DirectoryOfficial: Browsing the official Colony Nexus directory.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DirectoryCustom: Browsing {0} - set this back to blank for the official one.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DirectoryPlaytest: Playtest build: browsing the playtest directory, {0}. The full release uses the official one.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_DirectoryCustomPlaytest: Browsing {0} - set this back to blank for the playtest directory.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_UseApiTransportTip: On by default - the recommended path for newer RWT builds. Falls back to chat if the port can't be reached. Reconnect for changes to take effect.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_AllowChatFallbackTip: If the Colony Nexus API port can't be reached, keep using the RWT-chat transport so Colony Nexus still works.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_FallbackPort: Fallback port (only if a server advertises none)
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_HostOverride: Host override, every server (blank = the one you joined)
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_EnforcementApplied: A server config profile is applied to your Config folder. Restoring puts your personal configs back (it re-applies if you rejoin an enforcing server).
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_RestoredConfigs: Colony Nexus: restored your personal config files. Restart RimWorld to load them.
LanguageData.KMH_Settings_NoEnforcement: No server config profile is applied.
LanguageData.KMH_Recover_None: There is no other mod list on this computer that Colony Nexus can offer. Your current list stays as it is; you can change it on RimWorld's Mods page.
LanguageData.KMH_Recover_Intro: These lists were saved on this computer before a server changed yours. Choose one to use it, or close this window to keep your current list. Your current list is kept too, so this can be undone the same way.
LanguageData.KMH_Recover_Confirm: Use the {0} list from {1}? Your current list is saved first, and RimWorld has to restart to load the change.
LanguageData.KMH_Recover_Failed: That mod list could not be used: {0}
LanguageData.KMH_Recover_ModSync: Your list before the last server change
LanguageData.KMH_Restore_KeptChange: You changed your mod list after Colony Nexus set it, so your current list was kept. The list from before is still saved: "Recover an older mod list" in Colony Nexus's settings can bring it back.
LanguageData.KMH_Restore_CopyWasServers: The copy Colony Nexus kept of your own mod list turned out to be a server's list: an earlier Colony Nexus build replaced it. Your current list was kept; the lists that can still be recovered are shown next.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_AwaitRestart_Title: Restart to load your own settings
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_AwaitRestart_Body: Your own settings for {0} are back on disk, but RimWorld still holds the server's in memory. They load when RimWorld restarts; until then they can't be changed here, because saving now would write the server's values over yours.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_StillApplied: The mod settings of the last server you played on that enforces them are still in place. Put your own settings back now? RimWorld restarts to load them. Keep the server's if you are going back there - they can be restored later from the main menu.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Restored_Title: Your own mod settings are back on disk.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Restored_Tip: RimWorld still holds the server's settings in memory until it restarts, so those mods' options stay locked until then.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Leftovers_Title: {0} mod setting file(s) still hold a server's settings.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Leftovers_Why: An older Colony Nexus kept no copy of yours to put back.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Leftovers_Confirm: Remove these {0} file(s) so those mods start from their own defaults? A file you have changed since is kept. RimWorld restarts afterwards.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Leftovers_Failed: Those settings could not be reset: {0}
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_RestoredOnJoin: Colony Nexus put your own mod settings back. They load the next time RimWorld starts; until then those mods' options stay locked.
LanguageData.KMH_Consent_BootFailed: Last time these settings were applied, RimWorld did not reach the main menu, and your own were put back. Applying them again may do the same.
LanguageData.KMH_Consent_OrderRefused: This server's mod list will be refused: {0}
LanguageData.KMH_Consent_ReviewNext: Before anything is written you are shown which mods' settings change.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_BootRestored: RimWorld did not reach the main menu after the last server's mod settings were applied, so Colony Nexus put your own settings and mod list back. Restart RimWorld to load them.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Release_Button: Keep the current files and release the lock
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Release_Confirm: Colony Nexus cannot put your own settings back because its copy of them is missing or damaged. Release the lock and keep the files as they are now? The damaged copy is set aside, not deleted, and any file still exactly the server's is listed on the main menu so you can keep it or reset it.
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_Release_Failed: The lock could not be released: {0}
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_RestartAsk: This server's mod settings are in place, but RimWorld has to restart before every mod reads them. Restart now?
LanguageData.KMH_Enf_UnsafeRestored: The last server's mod settings named code a settings file never needs ({0}), so Colony Nexus put your own settings and mod list back. Restart RimWorld to load them.
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_ChangedSinceApproval: This server changed what it asks for since you accepted ({0}). Nothing more was changed on this computer. Cancel, then open Prepare and join again to see the new plan.
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_Changed_Old: this preparation was started by an older Colony Nexus
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_ReviewRwtOptIn: Install this RimWorld Together version anyway
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_RwtOld: RimWorld Together {0} is not one of its {2} newest releases (published {1}).
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_RwtOptInAgain: Start again from the browser and accept installing it, or install it yourself.
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_RwtPrerelease: RimWorld Together {0} is marked as a pre-release (published {1}).
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_SteamNew: published less than two weeks ago
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_SteamRefused: Steam does not list this number as a RimWorld mod
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_SteamTitlesUnread: Steam's own titles for these items could not be read, so only the server's names are shown. Check the Workshop numbers on Steam before you start.
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_WaitForList: Waiting for the server's mod list, so you can see what would change before agreeing to it.
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_WaitForSteam: Checking the Workshop items with Steam...
LanguageData.KMH_Prep_WorkshopRefused: Steam does not list {0} (Workshop {1}) as a RimWorld mod, so it cannot be subscribed.
LanguageData.KMH_Restore_ListOnly: Your mod list was put back, but the RimWorld Together copy could not be: {0}
LanguageData.KMH_Review_Intro: Colony Nexus has the server's settings and has not written anything yet. Your own copies are backed up first and can be put back at any time from the Colony Nexus tab, Mod Options, or the main menu.
LanguageData.KMH_Review_Merges: Sets the gameplay settings, keeping your personal ones, for
LanguageData.KMH_Review_ModListSame: No mod is switched on or off.
LanguageData.KMH_Review_Nothing: Every file already matches what you have.
LanguageData.KMH_Review_Restart: RimWorld restarts once afterwards so every mod reads its new settings.
LanguageData.KMH_Review_Unused: {0} file(s) are for mods you do not have running; they are stored but nothing reads them.
